title: Flaky: plugin-hono-server adapter-drain.test.ts "an idle keep-alive connection is released at drain start" reads the socket after a fixed 50 ms sleep
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Filing gate: (c) a residual that a card thread's queue eject names. Reported by seat 1's #34575 card thread (PR #35510 audit comment 7018063679). ⛔ Not a claim.

Grade: area:fleet · Bug · flaky test (a timing premise) · every merge-queue group that runs Test Core shard 10 · measured once: merge-queue run 44581618003.

## What happened

PR #35510 was ejected from the merge queue (run 44581618003, a group holding only that PR). The failure was in Test Core 10/10, `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server` `adapter-drain.test.ts`, case "an idle keep-alive connection is released at drain start": `expected undefined to be 'keep-alive'`.

- #35510's diff is not on that response's runtime path, and main `d2bc1ffd` is green on the same shard.
- The test writes the request, then `sleep(50)`, then parses the bytes it has received (around lines 241–243). Under a loaded runner the response hasn't arrived yet, so the header reads as `undefined`. This is the same class as a fixed timeout.
- This is the first occurrence in the 24-hour ledger.

## Fix

Wait on the socket for the response (or for its headers) with a bounded deadline, instead of a fixed sleep. Keep the assertion as it is. A shard-local retry, or a longer sleep, is not the fix.

## Done when

The case waits for the bytes it asserts on, and a loop run (for example 50 runs) under CPU pressure stays green.
